notes:
# BondoMod v0.2.29

- Added free Custom PFP for Epic Games: upload a picture for Rocket League’s native avatar fields. Images are converted automatically; close Rocket League before changing the picture or switching the feature on/off.
- Custom Cars is now a free installable plugin with a simple car list, previews, Apply confirmation, saved swaps and verified Revert.
- Added free Fake Friends for local friend-list entries. It requires Launch RL and shuts down with Rocket League; it does not create real friendships or online presence.
- Item colours and painted presets are now included in Lite and Plus, including existing licences. Title spawning now requires Plus; in-game title display and custom titles remain under development.
- Improved Launch RL preparation with parallel account/installation checks, consolidated network cleanup and an earlier launcher fallback. License-device bindings are retained.
- Improved recovery from rejected Name Changer connections. Existing Name Changer installations receive plugin version 2.0.3.
- Cleaned up the Items interface and Custom Cars layout, removed sidebar plugin icons and kept the red Launch RL notice in the main app.
- Rank Display remains disabled with “Developing in progress”. Existing item sharing and team-specific loadouts are retained.
- The website now includes What’s New: the latest ten public releases, Read more for the accumulated history, and automatic new-release updates. Plugin Requests are not included.
